DL-052.title: A source graph page carries at most thirty-two parent references for one node, and the rest are fetched on request
DL-052.question: q-001 in pldg-20260916-001-jujutsu-continuation-corrections
DL-052.verbatim_answer: for the parent referenced bound, lets do 32 then the ability to fetch the rest

DL-053.title: A source graph page never repeats a node reference, even on two identical rows
DL-053.question: q-003 in pldg-20260916-001-jujutsu-continuation-corrections, which refines F107
DL-053.verbatim_answer: Yes, forbid exact duplicates too, fold it in
DL-053.effect: SCS-017 states plain uniqueness; the gate rejects an exact duplicate row on the same rule as a conflicting one

semantic_gate.authorization: Jared, 2026-09-16, relayed by the reviewer; recorded as q-002 in pldg-20260916-001
semantic_gate.edit: scripts/pm-new-contracts-verify.py only: two constants, source_control_semantic_failures(), and one routing line in contract_semantic_failures. Nothing else under scripts/ was touched.

rules_enforced.rule: page.returned_count equals the number of emitted nodes
page.returned_count does not exceed the requested page.page_size
node_ref is unique within one page, whether or not two rows agree on revision_ref

semantic_gate.each_negative_fails_for_its_own_rule: Every semantic negative is structurally valid against the schema and returns exactly its declared rule, so none can pass by being malformed.
semantic_gate.scs_017_statement_removed: The 'they await a source_control_contracts branch in the existing contract semantic gate and are unenforced until then' sentence is replaced by a statement naming the enforcing branch.
semantic_gate.node_ref_rule_history: The first four commits enforced the criterion exactly as SCS-017 then stated it, forbidding only rows that share a node_ref while naming different revision_ref values, and carried the exact-duplicate case to the owner rather than assuming it. DL-053 answers it: uniqueness is the rule. The fifth commit tightens SCS-017's canonical text and criterion, replaces the conflict comparison in the gate with a seen-set, renames the rule code from source_graph_ambiguous_node_ref_in_page to source_graph_duplicate_node_ref_in_page, and adds a second negative for an exact duplicate row. The gate has never been stricter than canon.

parent_bound.truncation_marker: nodes[].parent_refs_truncated with nodes[].parent_expansion_cursor_ref; both required, both typed conditionals
parent_bound.fetch_the_rest: pm.source_control.source_graph_parent_expansion_request.v1, bounded at 32 per request, admitted only while the projection is current, carrying the same repository, workspace, backend, selected revision and projection identity and the same projection_generation as the page

picker.scope: the proposal's own dependency list and nothing else

picker.evidence_gating: a format is selectable only when a current capability catalog certifies engine, library, transport and provider as supported, each naming its evidence; otherwise it is disabled with a reason code, and unknown is never promoted or demoted
picker.no_command_admission: no command, handler, event or request meaning is added and the Jujutsu request enum stays at exactly 31; SCS-018 admission still gates anything runnable
